comments_text: Comment: RiLK1 exerted potent killing effects against the clinical isolate (MBC = 1.25 M), two-fold lower than those observed against the strain isolated from food products and those determined with the parental peptide 1018-K6 against ACSSuT strain, thus, suggesting that RiLK1 might have a high potential also in the medical field.
cytotoxicity_text: [Ref.32971824] It was observed that the cell viability was recorded as 98%, 98.7%, and 98.9% at the concentrations of RiLK1 (10, 25, 50 μM)
hemolytic_activity_text: No hemolysis information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
target_organism_text: [Ref.32971824] Gram-negative bacteria: E.coli (IC50 = 1.20 ± 0.10 μM, MBC = 2.0 μM), S. Typhimurium (IC50 = 1.30 ± 0.14 μM, MBC = 2.5 μM);##Gram-positive bacteria: S. aureus (IC50 = 1.98 ± 0.25 μM, MBC = 16.0 μM), L. monocytogenes (IC50 = 0.46 ± 0.01 μM, MBC = 2.0 μM);##Fungi: C. albicans ATCC 14053, A. brasiliensis ATCC 9341. Susceptibility testing clearly showed that RiLK1 was very effective, being able to inhibit 100% growth of both fungi at 25 μM concentration (MFC).
